name: flyrank-ml-internship
title_zh: 13 个技能打包上架，拆开是面试题闭卷答案
tagline_zh: 不用再翻 13 个仓库找零散 skill。这一包覆盖从数据清洗到模型部署的完整链路，每个都带可跑通的代码和注释。
tagline_en: Stop hunting 13 repos for scattered skills. This pack covers data cleaning to model deployment, each with.
why_zh: 不是技能列表，是别人踩过坑的完整项目骨架。每个 skill 都自带真实数据样例和预期输出。
why_en: Not a skill list, but battle-tested project skeletons. Each skill ships with real sample data and expected outputs, so you see.
limit_zh: 这是合集目录，不是单个技能。装完你得自己进每个子目录看 README 才知道怎么用；且内容基于作者个人项目。
limit_en: This is a collection index, not a single skill. You must open each subdirectory's README to use it; content reflects the author's projects, not all.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 13 skills in one pack: interview-ready ML project skeletons
